rhythm: A rhythm is the part of music that drums do. It's the way music goes in time, without thinking about higher or lower notes.
A healthy heart beats with a steady rhythm.
rhyme: If two words rhyme the end of the words sounds the same.
If you rhyme, you say words that rhyme.
Rhyming is a good way to remember some things.
A rhyme is two words (or a word and a phrase) that end with the same sound, including at least one vowel sound.
Agree" and "degree" make a rhyme, and "rhyme" and "time" are also a rhyme.
rhododendron: Rhododendron is a large genus of flowering plants. Most of them display their flowers quite aptly.
rhotic: If a sound in a word is rhotic, it has the sound the letter r makes in most American, Canadian, and Irish ways of talking.

If a dialect (form of a language) or accent is rhotic, it uses this sound after a vowel: often used in dividing English accents into the rhotic and the non-rhotic. (Note that all accents of English pronounce the rhotic sound if "r" or "rh" is immediately followed by a vowel – which means it is always pronounced at the start of a word.)
rhombus: A rhombus is a shape that has two pairs of parallel sides that have the same length.
All rhombuses are parallelograms, and all squares are rhombuses.
rhinoceros: A rhinoceros is a large gray mammal with thick skin and a horn on its head.
The rhinoceros is chasing against the cheetah.
rhapsodic: Something rhapsodic is filled with great pleasure and delight.
rhodium: Rhodium is a metallic (meaning made of metal) element with an atomic number of 45 and symbol Rh.
rhenium: Rhenium is a metallic (meaning made of metal) element with an atomic number of 75 and symbol Re.
rhodesia: Rhodesia was a country in Africa.
rhythmic: If something is rhythmic, it has or follows a rhythm.
If something is rhythmic, it occurs regularly
rheumatism: Rheumatism is any disorder of the muscles, tendons, joints, bones, nerves, that causess pain, discomfort or disability.
rhythmically: If a person plays an instrument rhythmically, the instrument is played with a rhythm.
rhetoric: Rhetoric is the art of trying to get someone to agree with you on an issue by speaking or writing in a convincing way.
rhodesian: A Rhodesian is a citizen of Rhodesia.
Something or someone that is Rhodesian comes from Rhodesia.
